Title: Public preview | Azure NetApp Files : Application Consistent Snapshot tool (AzAcSnap)

Body.Content:
Announcing the public preview of the Azure Application Consistent Snapshot tool (AzAcSnap). AzAcSnap is a command-line tool enables you to simplify data protection for third-party databases (SAP HANA) in Linux environments (for example, SUSE and RHEL).

Learn more: What is Azure Application Consistent Snapshot tool for Azure NetApp Files | Microsoft Docs
